proposals.evidence: Full lohila explicitly gives Palula lohílu/lᵊhōilo and Shina Kohistani līlṷ, Palesi līlo red. This supports the Palula lohīḷū and Chil/Gowro lhīlū survey colour forms. The latter shortened i-vowel forms are compared with the documented nīla crossing; no independent local crossing event is asserted. Source h, lateral quality and vowels remain intact; local history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Exact response: lhīlū.
